novelty_alignment_rationale: The student proposes a vector field approach with attraction/repulsion but misses the crucial anti-symmetric property and equilibrium-based training objective that defines Drifting Models.
novelty_gap: The student's approach lacks the anti-symmetric drifting field property (V_p,q = -V_q,p) and the equilibrium-based training formulation with stop-gradient targets.
